notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Sparring Mummy.
description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, adding an amount of {B} equal to Sparring Mummy's mana value.
When Sparring Mummy dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Repeat.
